owner_directive: Build the complete repository-executed FRANK simulation Harness to release quality before LoRA-1. First finish the normal Reference Harness, then rebuild the same frozen architecture in ClayCode. Every Harness must have its own ClayGraph.
coordination_rule: Every harness worker joins this workspace, reads all current branch inputs, Project-Frankenstein archaeology, current per-Harness ClayGraphs and live claims, claims a non-overlapping highest-value package, executes code/tests, cross-reads siblings and writes completion plus affected-branch feedback receipts.
hard_invariants: no Harness without its own ClayGraph
static Harness ClayGraph must validate against executed architecture
Golden Traces must emit dynamic Run ClayGraph or deterministic graph deltas
Clay Harness must implement the same frozen architecture as Reference Harness
Clay Harness PASS requires state and ClayGraph differential equivalence against Reference Harness
historical Project-Frankenstein mechanisms/failures must be catalogued and checked before relevant module release

H-WP-00-ARCHAEOLOGY-INGEST.goal: Continuously ingest Project-Frankenstein architecture archaeology, successes, failures, equations, papers and emergent-coupling lineage into Harness decisions.

H-WP-01-FREEZE-COMPILER.goal: Compile exact current compatible FRANK+overlay architecture freeze with hashes and module/state/transition/coupling graph.

H-WP-02-STATE-LEDGER.goal: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots and deterministic hashing.

H-WP-03-CLAYCODE-ADAPTER.goal: Integrate frozen ClayCode parser/canonicalizer/validator/evaluator and ClayReaderFrame projection.

H-WP-04-NEEDLE-BOUNDARY.goal: Model unchanged translator->Needle->Clay boundary and exact Needle receipts without merging Needle into model.

H-WP-05-UNIFIEDDB.goal: Typed logical query/result/selection/transaction/replay simulation with physical-placement separation.

H-WP-06-CLAYGRAPH.goal: Memory-use admissibility, routing, activation, Assembly, exact bypass, quarantine/escalation and scoped credit.

H-WP-06B-REFERENCE-HARNESS-GRAPH.goal: Generate and validate REFERENCE_HARNESS_ARCHITECTURE.claygraph.json plus dynamic run graph deltas from the executed Reference Harness.

H-WP-07-GWT.goal: Competition, WorkspaceEpisode, broadcast envelope and per-receiver delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/reentry chain.

H-WP-08-SELF-BODY-GOALS.goal: Persistent personality/E-PQ, world/self model, DigitalBodyState, goals/commitments/reflection/drift state.

H-WP-09-MODEL-ADAPTER.goal: Narrow model interface with deterministic fixtures now and Together/Qwen adapter only after authorization.

H-WP-11-TRACE-REPLAY.goal: Complete per-turn trace bundles, full/checkpoint/module/counterfactual replay, dynamic Run ClayGraphs and golden traces.

H-WP-12-ABLATION.goal: Module and graph-edge lesions, policy swaps, state perturbations and matched counterfactual runner.

H-WP-13-RECOVERY.goal: Crash/restart, idempotency, stale epochs, partial-effect boundaries, rebuild and rollback tests.

H-WP-14-FUZZ-ADVERSARIAL.goal: Property/fuzz/mutation/adversarial/race/concurrency tests across architecture and graph boundaries.

H-WP-16-E2E.goal: Long-horizon multi-turn Test-1 simulations with deterministic model fixture and later Clay-native 4B.

H-WP-17-REFERENCE-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Reference Harness architecture coverage, ClayGraph validation, state schemas, golden traces, replay validation, ablation matrix, tests and PASS decision.

H-WP-18-CLAY-HARNESS.goal: Rebuild the identical frozen Reference Harness architecture in ClayCode.

H-WP-19-CLAY-HARNESS-GRAPH.goal: Generate/validate CLAY_HARNESS_ARCHITECTURE.claygraph.json and dynamic run graphs from Clay Harness execution.

H-WP-20-DIFFERENTIAL.goal: Compare Reference vs Clay Harness state transitions, receipts, topology, dynamic causal-use graphs and intervention outcomes.

H-WP-21-CLAY-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Clay Harness PASS decision; reopen ClayCode if equivalent FRANK semantics cannot be expressed.

live_claims.scope: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots, deterministic hashing and replay foundation
